knowledge:
- key_parameters: nbins=The number of bins to divide the x-range into (e.g., 10 or 40); should be increased for datasets with more cells/nuclei ;; dimension_reduction=The dimension reduction representation to use (e.g., "UMAP", "PCA") ;; use_dims=A vector specifying which dimensions of the reduction to use (e.g., c(1, 2)) ;; col=The metadata column to plot or use for labeling (e.g., "cluster", "total", "nCount_RNA") ;; action=The summarization action for binning, such as "median", "majority", or "mean" ;; type=The assay type to extract features from (e.g., "counts", "logcounts") ;; feature=The gene or feature ID to plot (e.g., "CD1C", "POMGNT1")
- alternatives: Standard dimension reduction scatter plots (e.g., plotUMAP from scater or Seurat's DimPlot), which suffer from severe overplotting and obscured information when cell numbers are high.
- when_to_use: Use when visualizing large single-cell datasets where standard scatter plots suffer from overplotting, making it difficult to discern cell density, metadata distribution, or gene expression patterns.
- pitfalls: Choosing an inappropriate nbins value can lead to uneven cell distribution across hexagons; users should check the density plot and adjust nbins accordingly. Also, be aware of package deprecation warnings from dependencies (e.g., ggplot2's aes_string, scater's perCellQCMetrics, and scran's buildSNNGraph).

workflows.name: hexbin_plotting_workflow
workflows.intent: Bin single-cell reduced dimension coordinates into hexagons and visualize cell density, metadata, and gene expression.
input: pbmc_small (Seurat object with PCA and TSNE reductions)
tenx_pbmc3k (SingleCellExperiment object with PCA and UMAP reductions)
workflows.stages: 1. Convert Seurat object to SingleCellExperiment (optional) ;; 2. Calculate hexagon cell representation using make_hexbin ;; 3. Plot cell density in hexagons using plot_hexbin_density ;; 4. Plot metadata using plot_hexbin_meta and optionally label them using make_hexbin_label ;; 5. Plot gene expression using plot_hexbin_feature or plot_hexbin_feature_plus
workflows.code:
pbmc.sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(pbmc_small)
pbmc.sce <- make_hexbin(pbmc.sce,
    nbins = 10,
    dimension_reduction = "UMAP"
)
plot_hexbin_density(pbmc.sce)
plot_hexbin_meta(pbmc.sce, col = "nCount_RNA", action = "median")
gene_id <- "CD1C"
schex::plot_hexbin_feature(pbmc.sce,
    type = "counts", feature = gene_id,
    action = "mean", xlab = "UMAP1", ylab = "UMAP2",
    title = paste0("Mean of ", gene_id)
)
gg <- schex::plot_hexbin_feature(pbmc.sce,
    type = "counts", feature = gene_id,
    action = "mean", xlab = "UMAP1", ylab = "UMAP2",
    title = paste0("Mean of ", gene_id)
)
gg + theme_void()

tenx_pbmc3k <- make_hexbin(tenx_pbmc3k,
    nbins = 40,
    dimension_reduction = "UMAP", use_dims = c(1, 2)
)
plot_hexbin_density(tenx_pbmc3k)
plot_hexbin_meta(tenx_pbmc3k, col = "cluster", action = "majority")
plot_hexbin_meta(tenx_pbmc3k, col = "total", action = "median")
label_df <- make_hexbin_label(tenx_pbmc3k, col = "cluster")
pp <- plot_hexbin_meta(tenx_pbmc3k, col = "cluster", action = "majority")
pp + ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = label_df, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    colour = "black", label.size = NA, fill = NA
)
gene_id <- "POMGNT1"
plot_hexbin_feature(tenx_pbmc3k,
    type = "logcounts", feature = gene_id,
    action = "mean", xlab = "UMAP1", ylab = "UMAP2",
    title = paste0("Mean of ", gene_id)
)
plot_hexbin_feature_plus(tenx_pbmc3k,
    col = "cluster", type = "logcounts",
    feature = "POMGNT1", action = "mean"
)
